# SKILL rules

How a canonical skill (metator/skills/<name>/SKILL.md) is written, so a host loads it at the right moment and reads what it needs. `metator meta skills-lint` decides every rule; the guidance no tool can decide is in the skill mt-write-skill.

## Enforced by tools

CI fails on these; no need to re-check them by hand.

- MT-SKILL-001: A skill's name is kebab-case, its directory, prefixed, with no reserved word (`test:mt-skill-001`)
- MT-SKILL-002: A skill's description says what it does, when to use it and when not (`test:mt-skill-002`)
- MT-SKILL-003: A skill's body has the template's sections, in order, within 300 lines (`test:mt-skill-003`)
- MT-SKILL-004: A skill's supporting files are listed, named, one level deep and navigable (`test:mt-skill-004`)
- MT-SKILL-005: A skill names only skills that exist (`test:mt-skill-005`)
